AI Video Generator Online Free — initial release

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts or images, no editing software needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG file uploads up to 200MB.
- Simple authentication with 100 free credits for new users, valid for 7 days.
- Automated cloud rendering with ~1–2 minute processing and direct download links.
- Exposes core actions: upload, generate/edit, preview state, check credits, and export videos.
- Robust error handling and clear guidance for common issues (file type, size, export, credits).
